questions.questionText:
Text: The Chennai Metro carried 2.4 lakh passengers on Monday and 2.1 lakh on Tuesday.

Neither I nor II can be inferred
questions.explanation: An inference is valid only if it follows directly from the passage, using no outside knowledge; extra claims, predictions and reversals are rejected. 2.4 lakh > 2.1 lakh, so I follows. II predicts the future.
